for r in q(f"SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(amount),0) amt, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN {LO} AND {HI} GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt"):
    print(r)

    print(r)

for r in q(f"""SELECT c.acquisition_source src, c.group_id g, COUNT(*) leads,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.subscription_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) subs
FROM customers c LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE c.created_day BETWEEN {LO} AND {HI} AND c.customer_type='small'
GROUP BY src, g ORDER BY leads DESC LIMIT 15"""):
    print(r)

rows = q(f"""SELECT s.plan,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.end_day IS NULL OR s.end_day > {HI} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) surv,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.end_day BETWEEN {LO} AND {HI} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) chur
FROM subscriptions s
WHERE s.start_day <= {LO-31} AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
 AND (s.end_day IS NULL OR s.end_day >= {LO})
 AND ((({LO} - s.start_day) % 30 = 0) OR ((({LO} - s.start_day) % 30) >= 24))
GROUP BY s.plan""")
price={'A':79,'B':499,'C':189}
ts=tc=0
for r in rows:

import novamind_api as nm

# For each future week, dues among CURRENTLY ACTIVE subs: tested (start<=LO-31) vs firsts (not yet rebilled once)
for (LO,HI) in [(239,245),(246,252),(253,259),(260,266),(267,273),(274,280)]:
    rows = q(f"""SELECT
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day <= {LO-31} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) tn,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day <= {LO-31} THEN s.effective_price ELSE 0 END) tdues,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day > {LO-31} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) fn,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day > {LO-31} THEN s.effective_price ELSE 0 END) fdues
    FROM subscriptions s
    WHERE s.status='subscribed'
     AND ((({LO} - s.start_day) % 30 = 0) OR ((({LO} - s.start_day) % 30) >= 24) OR ((({LO} - s.start_day) % 30) < {HI-LO+1-30+24}))
    """)
    # simpler exact: day d in [LO,HI] is billing iff (d - start) % 30 == 0. r=(LO-start)%30; due iff r==0 or r >= 30-(HI-LO) = 24
    r = rows[0]
    print(f"wk d{LO}-{HI}: tested n={r['tn']} ${r['tdues']:,.0f} | firsts n={r['fn']} ${r['fdues']:,.0f}")
